display_name: 冻结特征复用：源样本计算图一致性检查
description: 合法源L_s/U_s各一条、四种固定扰动，比较在线与缓存参考特征、重复与共享F0图的数值、输入和代理参数梯度及AdamW单步；不修改在训模型。
authorization: 用户授权源L_s/U_s、冻结F0指导及效率优化；无TX/V/OE/target。代理Conv的比较性AdamW更新不属于恢复器训练。

code.environment: N607 CVS-RFFI CPU2 nice10, CUDA empty, FP32; actual F0 checkpoint.

data.version: Original R07 draw1 source training cache, fixed source indices0 and6300: one L_s, one U_s.
data.representation: Original source clean and received IQ 2x256; four existing deterministic 1% synthetic perturbations.
data.contract_ref: OriginalTriSIGSSL F0 source_contract andsource_pair metadata;R07 original63000source physicalset/roles matchbyID
data.physical_ids_ref: Fixed source array positions0 and6300; roles verified before reading IQ; physical IDs not needed.
data.label_map_ref: No TX truth, logits or classifier head calls; original F0 continuous features only.
data.tx_sets_ref: TX labels not read or used.
data.validation_ref: Existing VALIDATED_ONCE original R07 source cache / capsule / split, fixed original source-only Tri-SIG-TIME SSL F0.
data.support_query_ref: No target/query, source V/OE/novel inputs or fitted state.
data.leo_config_ref: Existing R07 draw1 only; no new simulated channel and no target.
data.actual_training_labels: No TX labels; toy Conv AdamW equivalence test only, no G training.
data.augmentation: Existing deterministic source perturbation directions at1% RMS.

permissions.query_use: One source L_s and one source U_s; no TX/V/OE/target or production G weight.
permissions.claim_scope: Two-source-record CPU numerical and autograd equivalence; not full production GPU parity, accuracy or speed.

checkpoint.initialization: Original frozen Tri-SIG-TIME SSL F0 E50; two identical freshly initialized toy 1x1 Conv models, seed193.
sources: SOURCE_INPUTS original R07 L_s/U_s clean, received draw1 and source-only F0 variance.
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Original F0 source identity and source R07 capsule/split; same two permitted rows; no target-derived weights.
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Original legal frozen source F0; fresh toy Conv only; no trained G or target-derived state.
checkpoint.selection_rule: Fixed source indices0/6300 and four epoch/direction cases; no scoring or model selection.

execution.gpu_policy: CPU2 nice10, CUDA empty; no GPU worker.
execution.stop_rule: Unexpected input/role/F0 identity, non-eval reader, nonfinite value or original/shared loss, input/parameter gradients or toy AdamW update differ at rtol1e-5/atol1e-6: preserve log and stop; no automatic retry.

metric_names: For four directions: maximum absolute cached/online reference feature, loss, restored/changed IQ gradients, toy Conv parameter gradients and toy AdamW step differences.
Report F0 unchanged, source roles and CPU-only / no target / no real G training.
dimensions: original vs feature-cached and autograd-shared computation
metrics_plan.prediction_ref: No target or truth prediction; original F0 continuous features on fixed two source records.
metrics_plan.scorer_ref: None; numerical assertions in same CPU process, no truth.

rows.purpose: Check CPU source-sample equivalence of four-direction cached F0 references and reuse of base F0 computation graph.
rows.seed_notes: Original F0 seed2026092701; fixed toy Conv seed193, fixed source indices0/6300; no random sample selection.
rows.scenario: Two source L_s/U_s IQ records and four fixed perturbation directions; no target.
rows.optimizer: Toy Conv AdamW lr.001 weight_decay1e-4, one comparison step each path per direction; no real G training.
rows.budget_ref: CPU2; 4 original vs shared/cached comparisons, 8 toy AdamW steps, original F0 frozen and no production G updates.

notes: Correctness of full production-G parameter gradients, GPU float32 kernels, training trajectory and speed are not established by this CPU toy-model diagnostic.
Direction cache indexing must match (source_index+epoch)%4, all original F0 feature computation remains frozen; no target selection.
Training tasks remain unchanged; failed mismatch is retained and does not modify running models.
